content:
Hello,
as a hobby project I let AI prove the correctness of a solver for a card game. I wrote the solver years ago. It is not trivial using hash tables and several optimizations to reduce the number of visited positions. It is 1000 lines of C translated (with AI) to 550 lines of Lean (stripping all comments). The rules of the game and the correctness statement were hand coded (about 300 lines) and then I helped the AI to build the proof in several sessions. The full proof is 47000 lines of Lean.

Here is the project: https://github.com/jhoenicke/seahaven/tree/master/lean.
Nice! You are in Freiburg? Care to join the irregular Lean lunch?
Sure, I'm in Freiburg. I'll send a DM.
